account.foremanBody: This app is for workers. Foremen manage work in the web CRM.
account.disabledBody: Ask your foreman to turn your account back on.

login.title: Field CRM
login.subtitle: Sign in with the login and password from your foreman.

intro.title: Location during your shift
intro.body: Field CRM records your location only between Start and Finish of a task, to confirm you are on site. A few random checks happen during the shift. Your location is never collected outside a shift.

foreground.title: Allow location
foreground.body: Needed to confirm you are on site when you start a task. Choose "While using the app".

background.title: Allow location all the time
background.body: Shift checks run while your phone is locked. On the next screen choose "Allow all the time". Checks still happen only during a shift, and you will see a notification while it runs.

notifications.title: Allow notifications
notifications.body: We need to tell you if a check shows you have left the site.

consent.denied: This permission is required to work shifts. Turn it on in Settings.

task.anotherShift: Another shift is already running. Finish it first.
task.takeBeforePhoto: Take a photo of the site before you start
task.checksOff: Location checks are off. Turn them back on to continue your shift.
task.finishBody: Location checks will stop and the task will be marked as done.

shift.offSite: You're {{meters}} m from the site. Move within {{radius}} m and try again.
shift.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to take the photo.
shift.serviceBody: Your location is checked from time to time until you finish work.

leftSite.title: You left the site
leftSite.body: A location check shows you're away from the site. When will you be back? Your foreman will see your answer.
leftSite.notificationBody: When will you be back? If you don't answer in 10 minutes, your foreman will be told.

locationOff.intro: You're on shift, and location checks can't run.
locationOff.servicesBody: Turn location back on to continue.
locationOff.permissionBody: Allow location "All the time" for Field CRM in Settings.
locationOff.foremanWarning: If it stays off for more than 2 minutes, your foreman will be notified.
locationOff.finishBody: The task will be marked as done.
locationOff.notificationBody: Turn it back on to stay on shift, or your foreman will be notified.
